snippet.title: DESCENT DOWN INFINITY - Game Jam Trailer
snippet.description:
DESCENT DOWN INFINITY is a psychological horror game made in 7 days for the 2026 Toasty Jam 2 by Juno, DanApan, and Daver The Dave.
https://junosfunworld.itch.io/descent-down-infinity

Descend down into the abandoned underground megastructure of Helix-8 and uncover what's happened to the people there.
As the newest member of the Infinity Inc. family, your goal is to retrieve important data from the very heart of the city, The Core. 

LISTEN TO THE SOUNDTRACK:
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/13cAaU0vbgzNoh8Wkn0UUL?si=jM8DSqJkQBCqHTJ02wB5gQ
